args.reason: The --dry-run item serves the inspection goal, but the persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log and the --explain timeline with --since and --format filters are historical storage and query features. The first PRD goal explicitly puts those out of scope. The Phase-1 claim that this is a natural extension of inspection misreads a goal that is limited to the current decision. The DoD capability set goes beyond the declared goals.
